sources.title: GitHub - cyttic/synt-text-combinator
sources.snippet: Static fonts give perfect text fidelity but zero style diversity; raw DiffusionPen gives style diversity but hallucinates text. sources.title: Every Grok AI Model Explained and Compared (Aug, 2026)
sources.snippet: Every current Grok model also reads images and calls tools, so you can build agents that see and act, not just chat. Pricing compared across the lineup Grok is cheap for its class. Output tokens drive most cost, and the flagship output is $2.50 per million, well below the flagship price of most Western labs.
